gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Kobi Kunasekaran agreed to review and follow up on the brand ambassador assignment coming from the S API, confirmed that renaming "registration date" to "agency signup date" is acceptable, and agreed to handle database and Single Link Controller data separately (00:09:07).
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: ... Sorry. Complete database and SLC data. I will follow up on this. I just need to double check. I'm pretty sure we're setting this separately now um and not coming from SLC data.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary is firmer: Kobi did not agree to handle it separately; he said he believes it is already set separately and must double check and follow up. Summary also expands SLC as 'Single Link Controller' (SLC = study link click).

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Furthermore, Kobi Kunasekaran suggested adding a new banner for a blank primary email and noted that moving the related referral profile to the player information box requires defining supporting fields for brand ambassador profiles (00:10:29).
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Related player related referral profile makes sense to move this up to the player information box. If a player is a BA, should it also link to their BA profile in the player object? Don't think we considered this scenario. So, we may need to figure out like how to like what are the supporting fields that we'll need for that one.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary merges two points. In the transcript, moving the referral profile 'makes sense' with no condition; the supporting-fields need is for the separate, unconsidered scenario of linking a player who is a BA to their BA profile.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Taryn Reithofer noted that other tasks focus on redeposits, payouts, and tickets awaiting requirements from Emily, such as determining fields for creating a new global operator action (00:05:28).
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Taryn Reithofer: Um yeah, and then other than that, um I don't have very much left because a lot of it's related to redeposits and payouts.
gemini_disagreements.why: Low severity. Summary frames redeposits/payouts as Taryn's current focus; transcript says she has little left because much of it relates to redeposits and payouts (implies that work is not active).
